probe_trace_diagnostics.limitations: Original exact-point metrics and every raw global maximum remain unchanged. The neighborhood samples expose possible discontinuous element stress traces without averaging or selecting a preferred trace. Additional predeclared interior probes diagnose depth/interface sensitivity and do not replace the original acceptance observable or establish a global volume norm. Geometry, loads and all solved fields are immutable; no new equilibrium solve or physical convergence is claimed. Original geometry/contact/model/feedback/full-application and verified-cost gates remain.

limitations: Full original two/three/four-layer fields, unchanged actual boundaries/geometry/mass and all15 boundary-traction/field audits are retained. Raw peak/energy stability does not override remaining full-tensor changes. Large NPZ files use exact ordered byte chunks; no arrays or records are reduced. Additional probes and unsmoothed one-sided neighborhoods diagnose the existing discrepancy without replacing original observables. Finer layers and full original physical/contact/model/feedback/verified-cost gates remain open. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
